LLFs are more than just digital art. These citrusy characters come to life as playable Pixelverse Avatars, unlocking exclusive community events and future drops. A growing Lemonverse bursts with surprises, unveiling our own captivating story. Own a piece of this playful, sweet n sour world. Get ready to join and play with the freshest tribe today!

The future of Little Lemon Friends is bursting with flavour across fashion, gaming, food and collectibles.

Expect zesty streetwear, limited-edition merch, interactive experiences, exclusive physical items, exciting treats inspired by our CITRUS-Y CREW!

Stay tuned for our one-of-a-kind digital rewards and the golden opportunity to hunt treasure!
